text:
Anya Kapoor: Heads-up — planning a config toggle for `tenant.limit.override` tonight at 21:00 UTC. Quiet window, 15m smoke. Who can be custodian for the push and immediate rollback if needed?
Devon Chen: I can be on push until 21:30 UTC. what's the safe-default if we need to flip back?
Anya Kapoor: thanks @Devon. Safe-default is `override=false` (current live). New value is `override=true` for the canary. If anything odd, flip back to false and scale batchers down.
Mike Rivera: How big is the canary? planned 3% of tenants?
Anya Kapoor: yep 3% to start, then 20% after 10m if metrics look green. Metrics: 99p latency, error-rate, and failed-requests-per-tenant.
Lina Patel (Product): quick note — notify Support if any tenant sees >3 failures in 10m. Ops playbook linked: <https://redwood.docs/playbooks/tenant-failure-response>
Devon Chen: rollback checklist (short):
- run `rctl flags set tenant.limit.override false`
- confirm config propagated in 2m via `rctl flags get tenant.limit.override --env prod`
- scale batcher to baseline: `infra batcher scale --to 1.0`
- post in thread + notify support on pager
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window recorded: 2026-03-17 21:00 UTC — duration 30m. ID: mw-2768412345
SRE Bot: Preflight smoke checks passed in staging: kv-cache, auth, quota. No regression flags.
Mike Rivera: Ping on db connections — should we pre-warm connection pool?
Anya Kapoor: yes, run `infra db warm --pool main --conns 50` 5m before flip. I'll trigger at 20:55 UTC.
Devon Chen: I'll do the push and watch metrics. If 99p > 250ms or errors > 0.5% during first 10m, I flip back and call incident if needed.
Lina Patel (Product): I'll draft a one-line to send to Support if rollback happens.
Anya Kapoor: small helper commands for push/rollback (copy):
```
# push canary
rctl flags set tenant.limit.override true --percent 3 --reason "evening canary"
# rollback
rctl flags set tenant.limit.override false --reason "rollback: perf/regression"
```
Mike Rivera: added a short dashboard check: /dashboards/tenant-limit-canary (watching 99p latency, errors, resource-usage).
Devon Chen: noted. I'll post final "done" when at 20:59 and start push at 21:00. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Anya Kapoor: thanks team — custodian: @Devon, backup: @Mike. Support notified. Will react here when done. :white_check_mark:
